name: willow_bush
description: Dense clump of boreal willow shrubs: thin upright reddish-brown stems, narrow yellow-green leaves, taller in the middle; the opaque leaf mass hides anything behind it up to about y -300 (centre) / -200 (edges). Anchor bottom-centre, x -215..215, y -385..0 (leaf tops; stems show bare in the bottom ~40).
